final_message:
I added the three views to `notebooks/explore.py`. The notebook runs top to bottom without errors and `marimo check` passes. I only ran it as a script, so I haven't seen the charts drawn in a live session.

**What I added:**
- **Shipments per month:** a line chart of shipment counts across all 24 months (2023-01 to 2024-12).
- **Second-quarter dip by port** and **by carrier type:** horizontal bars with a table under each. Each bar compares Q2 shipments with the average of the other three quarters of the same year, shown as a percent change. Red means Q2 was lower. 2023 and 2024 are shown separately. Both views use one shared `q2_dip(by)` function, and I added `altair` to the imports cell.

I measured the dip against the same year's other quarters, using shipment counts rather than TEU. You could also compare Q2 with the previous year's Q2. Changing that, or switching to TEU or value, is a small edit in `q2_dip`.

**What the data shows:** the dip is almost entirely in 2024. Q2 2023 was about normal.
- **By carrier type (2024):** tanker −44%, container −29%, bulk −6%.
- **By port (2024):** three ports account for most of the dip: Fennick −80%, Ivelholm −78% and Brackwater −64% (each had 4 to 7 shipments, against the usual 18 to 20). Juniper Reach, Glassford and Cindervale were actually up 16% to 26%.

The counts per port and quarter are small, so treat the percentages for the smaller ports with some caution.

p='notebooks/explore.py'

@app.cell
def monthly_view(alt, mo, pl, shipments):
    monthly = (
        shipments.group_by(month=pl.col("ship_date").dt.truncate("1mo"))
        .agg(shipments=pl.len())
        .sort("month")
        .collect()
    )
    monthly_chart = (
        alt.Chart(monthly)
        .mark_line(point=True)
        .encode(
            x=alt.X("month:T", title="Month"),
            y=alt.Y("shipments:Q", title="Shipments"),
            tooltip=[alt.Tooltip("month:T", format="%b %Y"), "shipments:Q"],
        )
        .properties(title="Total shipments per month", width="container")
    )
    mo.ui.altair_chart(monthly_chart)
    return


@app.cell
def q2_dip_helper(pl, shipments):
    def q2_dip(by):
        """Q2 shipments vs. the mean of the other three quarters, per year and group."""
        quarterly = (
            shipments.group_by(
                by,
                year=pl.col("ship_date").dt.year(),
                quarter=pl.col("ship_date").dt.quarter(),
            )
            .agg(shipments=pl.len())
            .collect()
        )
        return (
            quarterly.group_by(by, "year")
            .agg(
                q2=pl.col("shipments").filter(pl.col("quarter") == 2).sum(),
                other_q_mean=pl.col("shipments").filter(pl.col("quarter") != 2).mean(),
            )
            .with_columns(
                dip_pct=((pl.col("q2") / pl.col("other_q_mean") - 1) * 100).round(1)
            )
            .sort("year", "dip_pct")
        )

    return (q2_dip,)


@app.cell
def q2_dip_by_port(alt, mo, q2_dip):
    dip_by_port = q2_dip("port")
    port_chart = (
        alt.Chart(dip_by_port)
        .mark_bar()
        .encode(
            x=alt.X("dip_pct:Q", title="Q2 vs. other-quarter mean (%)"),
            y=alt.Y("port:N", sort="x", title=None),
            color=alt.condition("datum.dip_pct < 0", alt.value("#d62728"), alt.value("#2ca02c")),
            row=alt.Row("year:O", title=None),
            tooltip=["port", "year", "q2", alt.Tooltip("other_q_mean:Q", format=".1f"), "dip_pct"],
        )
        .properties(title="Second-quarter dip by port")
    )
    mo.vstack([mo.ui.altair_chart(port_chart), dip_by_port])
    return


@app.cell
def q2_dip_by_carrier(alt, mo, q2_dip):
    dip_by_carrier = q2_dip("carrier_type")
    carrier_chart = (
        alt.Chart(dip_by_carrier)
        .mark_bar()
        .encode(
            x=alt.X("dip_pct:Q", title="Q2 vs. other-quarter mean (%)"),
            y=alt.Y("carrier_type:N", sort="x", title=None),
            color=alt.condition("datum.dip_pct < 0", alt.value("#d62728"), alt.value("#2ca02c")),
            row=alt.Row("year:O", title=None),
            tooltip=["carrier_type", "year", "q2", alt.Tooltip("other_q_mean:Q", format=".1f"), "dip_pct"],
        )
        .properties(title="Second-quarter dip by carrier type")
    )
    mo.vstack([mo.ui.altair_chart(carrier_chart), dip_by_carrier])
    return
'''
